generators.carrier: Berry phase of adiabatic half-braid of two quasiholes in the nu=1/m Laughlin state
Berry phase around closed quasihole loop

relations.statement: Berry phase for one quasihole encircling another is 2*pi/m (the Aharonov-Bohm term from the enclosed fractional charge 1/m cancels out of the background-flux contribution)
relations.hypotheses: Laughlin nu=1/m wavefunction, plasma screening assumption, adiabatic transport, background flux term subtracted

relations.statement: Exchange phase theta equals half of the full-encirclement phase: theta = (1/2)*(2*pi/m) = pi/m
relations.hypotheses: Abelian anyons, 2D, exchange is half-braid with path-independence of the phase

lemmas.statement: For the Laughlin nu=1/m state, the adiabatic exchange of two quasiholes yields statistical phase pi/m
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem exchange_phase (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : (1:ℚ)/2 * (2/m) = 1/m := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Using the raw Berry phase without subtracting the Aharonov-Bohm background-flux contribution gives the statistical phase
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Statistical phase is the part of the Berry phase proportional to enclosed quasihole charge deficit, not the magnetic flux term

near_misses.claim: The full encirclement phase 2*pi/m equals the exchange phase
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Exchange is a half-braid; the full braid is the square of exchange, so theta_full = 2*theta
